scope: Read-only review of prepared local cutover controller, readback reader and runtime templates; no switch or rollback executed by reviewer.

checks.check: Exact resolved commit and root-approval record precede switch; empty queued/running jobs, pending media and external delivery rows required; pause then recheck pending work.
Stop old API and all its exec workers before copying SQLite/WAL/SHM; create private consistent backup and check integrity; no snapshot is copied back into the live database.

Candidate uses exact old image, existing volume mounts, loopback3457 and old networks; source comes from fixed Git archive and dependency manifests must match; original containers and volumes are retained.
API verifies CANDIDATE_SOURCE_SHA against source-lock and every archived file before importing /app/src/main.ts; Worker independently checks the same source-lock and environment SHA.
Local Worker allows four exact Ghost routes and local Nyx/CMS origins only; loads release/projection workers, excludes DeliveryWorker and refuses pending delivery jobs.

Rollback pauses/stops unhealthy candidate, verifies old container ID, restarts old API with current database; restarts Worker/restores outbound only if queues remain empty and prior pause was false. Pending work is preserved and remains paused.
Reader checks actual source hashes, environment SHA, live Worker PID/script, reviewed template hashes, empty queues and restored pause value.

Reader creates a separate consistent SQLite backup from a read-only database handle; uses immutable read-only connections, checks baseline backup hash, exact schema, all prior row multiplicities/BLOBs, integrity and FK constraints. Only outbound pause row excluded from prior-row comparison.

Reader preserves prior ID/image and every existing name/destination/rw mount field with identical array multiplicity, comparing mount arrays sorted by destination; preserves running flags for all 19 snapshot containers, expects only old386-r2 to stop, retains old0b stopped, and verifies candidate image/mounts/user/cmd/network/port and healthy endpoints.

conditionsBeforeSwitch: Root runner must require independent code-review PASS and original-business-renderer native PASS explicitly bound to candidate c16cde700963959d3fd7fc226853b71f5551573a; a diagnostic-copy pass or baseline386 pass is not a substitute.
Root approval must include exact candidate SHA and concrete reviewed evidence; controller only checks nonempty reviewEvidence, so runner must inspect evidence status and source binding.
Runner must hold runtime-heavy.lock using exclusive creation and release only its own lock identity; do not replace an existing lock.
Runner must verify the hashes listed in this review and the current old-container/configuration preimage immediately before switch; drift requires re-review.
Use allowedSchemaAdditions=[] for this renderer-only source change.
Run runtime-verify.py after controller returns and treat any readback failure as cutover failure; runner must invoke rollback because the standalone reader is outside controller.switch try/except.
Retain both old386-r2 and old0b containers, all data volumes and private backups; rollback must preserve current database rather than restore a stale snapshot.
limitations: Runner had not yet been provided or reviewed; this is conditional approval of the fixed controller/reader only.
No live switch, rollback rehearsal, native acceptance or global D1-D9 acceptance is claimed by this review.
Prior-row retention admits additional audit rows and does not claim byte-identical database files.

amendment.reason: Actual isolated cleanup observed Docker Mounts array order variation with identical mount contents.
amendment.readerChange: Sort selected mount records by destination before equality comparison; each existing compared field and array multiplicity remain required.

provenance.boundary: Relative source/log/script paths refer to retained private continuation evidence unless included in this public manifest. Raw databases, environments, credentials and backups are not included.
